task: open-tennis-robots: lift drive shaft (flagship 10 BUILDABLE item)

doc_friction.issue: Ran git stash in a checkout while a background build was writing manufacturing/; nothing warns against it. Had to kill and rerun the 10-minute build.

deviations.why: Free-choice slot used on a flagship BUILDABLE item: a broad look for a new product or sweep found each idea already in the repo, and a finishable engineering slice beat another duplicate.

goal: Close the slip hub's open question: 63 mm of 6 mm D shaft past the gearmotor's face
notes: Idea: explore slot spent on the allocator's flagship pick after a sweep of ventures/ for an unbuilt product found every candidate (VRP, nesting, battery dispatch, runtime JS sweeps) already present. Built: Feeder.lift_shaft_design/geometry, d_shaft_section, check_lift_shaft; CAD parts lift_shaft, lift_shaft_bearing (F626 x2), lift_shaft_coupler, lift_motor_spacer, bearing pockets and insert holes in the boot. Findings: the old layout put the 85 N jam load 38 mm out on the gearbox (3.2 N m vs an assumed 0.5); a rigid coupling with a far bearing is overconstrained (0.3 mm print error -> 17 N); the collision check showed the 100 mm base gearmotor hits the drive bracket once set out, so lift_gm_len = 75 (assumed, no encoder); the lift lead was rerouted between motor and bracket. Verification: feeder package rebuilt (design_rules [], collisions []); venture unittest 112 OK; cad tests/test_cad.py full run (see PR); check_post_frontmatter and check_post_links clean.
